description: Aggregate statistics over a simulated restriction digest of a linear or circular molecule with named enzymes (any of the 754 REBASE enzymes with a defined cut).

sequence.description: DNA sequence to digest. IUPAC ambiguity codes are accepted anywhere in the sequence (N, R, Y, ...), so an N-containing contig or a soft-masked assembly can be digested as it is: a site N matches any of the 15 IUPAC codes, every other site code matches only a concrete A/C/G/T base it expands to, and a character outside the 15 codes (U, a space, a FASTA header line) matches nothing — Biopython's own rule; such text is not rejected, but it still occupies coordinates and cannot be part of a site. Lower case is accepted; the returned fragment and site sequences are upper-case (the soft mask is not carried over; positions and lengths are unaffected).

enzyme_names.description: Names of restriction enzymes to use.

topology.description: Linear (default) or Circular: whether the molecule is a linear fragment or a closed circle (plasmid).

methylation.description: Optional methylation-aware recognition (EMBOSS restrict -methylation semantics): "none" (default), "dam" (GmATC), "dcm" (mCmCAGG, mCmCTGG), "dam+dcm" or "emboss" (all five Emethylsites.dat entries incl. EcoKI). Case-insensitive. A recognition window containing a methylated base is NOT a site (a window rule, not an enzyme-specific sensitivity table; BamHI is blocked by Dam).

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
At least one enzyme name is required
Unknown methylation set '{name}'; expected none, dam, dcm, dam+dcm or emboss.
The topology must be MoleculeTopology.Linear or MoleculeTopology.Circular.

examples.name: EcoRI digest of a circular molecule with an origin-spanning site
